name: Frozen Bloodworms
description: Whole frozen chironomid (midge) larvae — a generic frozen-food archetype, not a single brand. proteinPct is omitted: as a frozen whole food it carries no standardized guaranteed-analysis crude-protein label, and inventing one would violate the honesty contract. wasteFactor (0.15) is MODELLED — whole foods are eagerly eaten with little waste when fed to appetite.
notes: Frozen and live foods share one model bucket (whole, low-waste). High moisture and no published protein figure — feed sparingly as a treat; thawed leftovers foul quickly so net out the excess.
